_comment: aspens: Map 6 first pass, one sculpt exported as 14 chunks (aspens_build.py writes aspens.chunks.json, which carries each chunk's own node_paths): aspens_ground.glb (AspensGround), aspens_stump.glb (AspensStump), aspens_near0..7.glb (AspensNear0..7), aspens_far0..3.glb (AspensFar0..3). Each chunk ships its own -colonly collider. World coordinates, instanced at identity. Notes in docs/maps/aspens.md.
